description: BoothIQ is lead capture for trade shows, conferences, and executive dinners. Reps scan badges, business cards, and name tags, and leave voice notes about each conversation. BoothIQ turns every capture into a lead with contact details, notes, an AI summary, and next steps. Connect BoothIQ to ask about that data in plain English. See every event your organization attended and how many leads each one brought in. See which reps captured the most leads. Search leads by name, company, or notes. Open a lead to see contact details, notes, the conversation summary, and next steps. BoothIQ is read only: ChatGPT cannot create, change, or delete anything in BoothIQ. Each person signs in with their own BoothIQ account and sees only their organization's data.

defaultPrompt: Who did we meet at our last trade show?
Which of my leads have follow-up tasks?
How many leads did we get at each event?
